body.name: \(U_{\mathrm{PB}}(n,r,s)\)
body.construction: \(U_{\mathrm{PB}}(n,r,s)=\begin{cases}\min\left\{\binom nr,\ \min_{r\le k\le s}\left\lceil\frac{\log\!\left(n\binom{n-1}{r}\right)+1}{p_{n,r,k}}\right\rceil\right\},&r\le s<n-1,\\ \min\left\{\binom nr,\ n,\ \min_{r\le k\le n-1}\left\lceil\frac{\log\!\left(n\binom{n-1}{r}\right)+1}{p_{n,r,k}}\right\rceil\right\},&s=n-1.\end{cases}\)
